balls.text: Sarfaraz loses it in the lights, and David has turbocharged RCB to 250! Full on the pads. David walks down the track and flicks it to deep mid wicket. Sarfaraz does not know where the ball is, and it bobbles past him and into the fence!
another top wide yorker. Patidar cannot do much with it apart from clinking it off the toe-end towards sweeper cover
full and wide. David throws his hands at it and drills it out towards sweeper cover
top yorker outside off. Patidar jams down on it and digs it out towards deep point
high full toss outside off. Patidar tries to hit it too hard and shanks it back to the bowler
full, wide and into the stands it flies! This is like a video game now. Too much width on offer and Patidar scythes it over deep point!
onto the roof, and onto the metro station! Or somewhere in the near vicinity! Half-way down outside off. David rubs his eyes in disbelief before clattering it an absolute mile over deep mid wicket!
the sixes keep getting bigger and bigger! Right in the slot outside off. David winds up and clobbers the living daylights out of this. Clean over the sightscreen!
a 21-ball fifty for Tim David, and the Chinnaswamy erupts! A lot of RCB fans will end up with sore throats tonight, if David keeps this going. Full outside off and David pumps it over mid on!
when it is going your way, it all goes your way! Banged in short just outside off. David rushed on the pull and the ball flies off the top edge over the keeper!
low full toss outside off. David has a wild swipe at it and squirts it off the inside edge past short fine leg. Back for a brace
into the stands yet again! Slot ball outside leg. David can pick his spot and he plunders it over the long leg fence!
into the blockhole outside off. David cannot get under this and scuffs it out to long off
full toss on a Free hit and of course David takes full toll! Proper buffet ball outside off and David helps himself to a thump over mid on!

Kamboj outwits David, and the stumps have been shattered again! Searing yorker on leg. David pre-empts another wide delivery and walks across his stumps. Too far to then make contact and his leg stump is pegged back. But there is a reprieve for David because Kamboj has overstepped. Oh dear...

finally nails the wide yorker. David swings at it with all his might and misses. But hang on, he thinks this should be a wide. Did not seem so in real-time but why not have a look. David has walked a shade across his stumps and the ball is well inside the tramlines. RCB lose a review!
into the blockhole outside off. David cannot get under it and squeezes it past extra cover for a couple of runs

zipped in full on leg stump. Right in the slot and Kamboj is lucky he does not have to fetch this back from Cubbon Park. David misses his swish and gets rapped on the pad. David livid with himself too
Kamboj greeted with a boundary! Low full toss laced with width. David throws the plumbing at it and pummels it past extra cover!
shortish just outside off. David hangs back and jabs it towards sweeper cover
David is on a rampage now, and this crowd is loving it! Another half-tracker outside off. David has all the time in the world to line it up and slap it over deep cover!
David's party has well and truly begun now! This is another feeble attempt at a hard length delivery. Sits up on middle and leg and David dismisses it over deep mid wicket!
serious, serious power! Googly dropped short outside off. David sits deep in his crease and forehands it over long off!
back of a length just outside off. Patidar shapes for the reverse and misses. Samson fumbles too and RCB pinch a bye
leg-spinner on a full length on middle and leg. David comes forward and drives it towards deep extra cover
this has gone miles! Khaleel dishes out another length ball into Patidar's wheelhouse, and he gets met. Patidar gets his front foot out of the way and wallops it over deep mid wicket!
four more! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Patidar holds his swing and then slices it over backward point!

big, big lbw shout but not given! CSK review now! Excellent yorker, zoning into off stump. Patidar has a swing across the line and seems to miss, with the ball later kissing the back leg. Was he struck outside off and was it going beyond the stumps with the angle? Well, nothing doing on either of those counts because Patidar has gotten a scratch on it. Right off the toe-end, and the RCB skipper stays!
my word - this is some shot! Low full toss outside off. Patidar peels the outer cover off the ball and carves it over extra cover!

slower bumper outside off. Patidar tries to force it through the off side but only swishes at thin air. Patidar asks his partner whether it is worth the review, and goes upstairs. This could be touch-and-go. Had a bit of a loopy trajectory. Ball Tracking comes up. Patidar's head is measured at 1.81m and the ball is crossing the batter at 1.87m. No bat involved either, so the wide will be called, after all!
shortish outside off. David winds up and hoicks it towards deep backward square leg
hard length on the stumps. Patidar gives himself room and punches it uppishly towards sweeper cover
off-pace on a back of a length on off. Patidar too early into the pull and the ball bobbles off the back thigh behind point
length ball hung up wide outside off. David throws his hands at it and flays it on the bounce to sweeper cover
slanted in full on the stumps. David pokes it back to the bowler, who gets his boot in the way. That was bowled at 145.4kph
oh! Back of a length in the channel and this skips through. Bowled at 148.6kph and David, swishing at it, is beaten for pace
zipped in full on middle and leg. David plays with the angle and tucks it to mid wicket

leg stump out of the ground, and Overton provides a bit of respite to CSK! Yorker speared in on leg stump. Padikkal walks across and tries to be too funky. Looks for the scoop but gets across far too much to access the ball. Misses it and sees his leg stump flat on the ground soon after. Overton is pumped, but Padikkal has done his job too through these middle overs!
another short ball outside off. Rushes onto Padikkal and he cloths his pull to long on. Brings up a half-century, though - and this has been an amazing knock after a tricky teething period!
short, wide and this is too easy! Padikkal has the freedom of the Chinnaswamy to work with and he thunders it over extra cover!

dug into the track on leg. Padikkal gets under it and the square leg umpire calls it a wide on height. But hang on. CSK have reviewed it. And Ball Tracking reckons the ball is 0.01m under the head. Wide call overturned, and that is some shrewd reviewing, as it rurns out!
dropped again! Back of a length outside off. Padikkal reaches out for it and slaps it flat towards extra cover. Gaikwad lunges to to his right but cannot make a tough chance stick!
slower bumper on off. Patidar hangs back before hacking it to deep mid wicket
and Henry travels too! This is effortless batting. Slot ball outside off. Patidar goes through the line and just bunts it over mid off!
23 off the over! Right in the slot just outside off. Padikkal loads up, gets his front foot out of the way and bludgeons it back past the bowler!
four more! Dube being torn apart this over! Padikkal knows this is going to be wide, and that it is going to be shortish too. He goes back and across before gliding it past backward point!
another stirring blow! This is a slower ball and this lands right in the slot outside off. Padikkal hares down the track and smokes it over wide long off!
length ball on middle and leg. Eased out to deep mid wicket

just over! Banged half-way down and this gets up to near the helmet. Patidar rushed on it and he miscues it off the bottom half of the way. Gets just enough to clear a leaping Noor at deep backward square leg!
back of a length outside off. Padikkal gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards sweeper cover
length ball hung up wide outside off. Padikkal lets it go and sees the umpire indulge in some exercise
back of a length outside off. Padikkal stays back and cuts it towards deep backward point
googly on a full length on middle. Patidar pushes it to long off
googly on a length on middle and leg. Spins in and beats Padikkal on the inside. Rolls off the back leg towards short third
oh, send an airplane to fetch that back! Given a bit of air on middle and leg. Padikkal dances down the track and launches it a mile over long on!
fired in on a length on middle and off. Patidar drops it into the off side and picks up a run
this is a sublime shot! Floated up full outside off. Patidar comes forward and takes on the long boundary, creaming it over sweeper cover!
short, wide and put away! Not the greatest ball Dube will ever bowl. Too much width on offer and Padikkal slashes it over short third!
back of a length just outside off. Patidar gets up on his toes and pats it to long on to open his account

Dube does the trick! Inspired bowling change, and Salt perishes! This is banged into the track outside off. Seems like the slower variant and it comes off very sluggishly. Salt has a wild swipe at it and shanks it a mile up. Noor runs in from deep square and snaffles up the chance. Timely breakthrough for CSK!
back of a length outside off. Padikkal goes back and across before tapping it towards backward point
well, this is almost a wide but on the other side. Full toss sliding down leg and Salt somehow chalks it behind square towards short fine. He will feel he missed out
slow, short and wide outside off. Salt jumps up onto his toes and tugs it towards extra cover
fired in full just down leg. Padikkal brings out the sweep and nudges it past short fine. Kamboj gives chase and keeps it to two
length ball on the pads. Salt hangs back and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Padikkal tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off and this fizzes through. Padikkal shapes for the cut but is beaten by the extra skid
leg-spinner on a length on off. Padikkal backs away before prodding it towards extra cover. Wants the single again but Salt is not as interested
angled in full on middle and off. Padikkal tips it to extra cover and sets off for a single, only to be sent back by his partner. Sent back in time, though
fuller just outside off. Padikkal has a big swing at it and slices it down to deep third. Keeps strike too
more runs! Length ball on middle and leg. Padikkal pre-empts the line, walks across his stumps and helps it over short fine leg!
length outside off. Padikkal comes forward and chips it over extra cover. Back for another brace
short and wide outside off. Salt reaches out for it and slaps it towards sweeper cover
full and wide outside off. Salt moves across his stumps and drills it towards mid off, who dives to his left and gets something behind it. Mhatre the fielder
short on leg. Padikkal looks for the pull but is a tad rushed on it. Cloths it towards deep backward square leg
darted in on a length on middle and leg. Padikkal tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
shorter outside off. Salt waits on it before cutting it towards sweeper cover
this is another mighty hit! Googly tossed up into the slot outside off. Salt gets down on one knee early and clobbers it over deep mid wicket!
length ball on middle and off. Padikkal goes back and knocks it to long on
googly on a back of a length just outside off. Salt chops it behind point and gets Padikkal on strike
zipped in very full just outside leg. Salt swings so hard at it that he ends up on the deck. Misses his stroke, with the ball pinging into his pad
hard length just outside off. Salt uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
that has flown to the fence! Leg-cutter but way too short. Sits up on middle and off and Salt obliterates it to deep mid wicket's right!
back of a length on off. Salt punches it to extra cover, where Ghosh, on as a sub, misfields and ends up conceding an extra run
up, up, and away! Marginally short on middle and leg. Salt swivels inside the line and muscles it just over the deep backward square leg fence!
shortish outside off and this sits up too. Salt hammers it but straight to extra cover. He will feel he missed out there
banged in short outside off and this sails past the batter. Salt lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide on height
shortish outside off. Padikkal gets on top of the bounce and jabs it towards deep point. A bit of hesitation on the second and Padikkal has to scramble to return to the bowler's end
shot! Strong way to end the powerplay! Half-tracker outside off. Salt sits back, picks the length early and belts it to mid on's right!
first run for Padikkal off Khaleel. Back of a length outside off. Padikkal stays back and scuffs it towards sweeper cover
length ball hung up outside off. Padikkal throws the kitchen sink at it but misses
back of a length on off. Salt goes deep into his crease before punching it to mid on. Another easy single
shortish outside off. Salt gets up on his toes and jabs it towards extra cover
slower ball on a length just outside leg. Salt too early into it and heaves it behind square. Not enough juice on the stroke, though, and cut off quite easily
hard length, nipping into off. Salt, cramped for room, jams it into the cover region
nicked and just past a diving Samson! That flew off the bat. On a back of a length, honing into off. Salt wafts at it and gets a thick enough outside edge to beat the keeper to his right!
back of a length just outside off. Padikkal has a stab at it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads. Rolls away for a single into the off side

bashed in short, and Kohli bites the dust! Dube with a bit of redemption! A little outside off. Kohli advances and tries to fetch it from outside the line. Gets a little under it and miscues it badly. Dube, stationed at long on, runs in and does the rest, despite the close proximity of Noor, who had run towards Dube from mid wicket. Kamboj with the breakthrough, and there is stunned silence at the Chinnaswamy!
Kohli continues on his merry way! Length ball just outside off. Kohli opens up his front hip and smears it over mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Kohli skips down the track and shanks it on the bounce to mid off. That seemed to stick in the surface too
back of a length on off. Kohli drops it into the mid wicket region and keeps strike
gorgeous, just gorgeous! Full just outside off. Kohli marches down the track, shows the full face of the bat and cracks it back past the bowler!
dug in and following the batter outside leg. Kohli, having advanced, short-arm-jabs it behind square for a couple of runs
full just outside off. Kohli plants his front foot again and scuffs it over the bowler's head. Back for a brace
pick the bones out of that one! And it is a no-look six to boot. On a length just outside off. Kohli plants his front foot and whips it over mid wicket!
over the top but this plugs too! Full just outside off. Salt gets under it and muscles it over mid on. The ball just stops in the surface after pitching and Dube can retrieve it!
length ball slanted across the batter outside off. Kohli has a wild swish at it and misses the ball by a fair distance. An un-Kohli-esque shot
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Salt waits for it and slaps it to mid off before scampering across to the other end
length ball shaping into the pads. Kohli has another swipe at it and seems to miss, with the ball rolling off the pad behind square

goes straight up, and Dube puts it down! Kohli breathes a sigh of relief! Hard length just outside off. Kohli has a hack at it and shanks it badly. Dube runs back from mid on, gets under it but the ball hits his hands and then his chest. Not a moment Dube will want to look back on again!
back of a length outside off. Salt tries the fight the angle away from him and slices it towards deep backward point
banged in short outside off and this comes off a touch sluggishly. Kohli tugs it enough to mid wicket's right and settles for a single
length ball outside off. Salt plants his front foot and drills it straight to mid off
hard length outside off. Kohli charges down the track before shanking it to mid on
top work on the fence! Marginally short outside off. Kohli stands up tall and whips a pull towards deep square, where Noor sprawls to his left and saves two
safe again! Fullish outside off and this leaves the batter a touch. Salt throws his hands at it and slices it down to deep backward point
back of a length just outside off. Kohli dabs it to short third and Khaleel misfields yet again. No extra runs conceded this time, though
back of a length outside off. Salt gets up on his toes and runs it down to short third, where Khaleel misfields and ends up conceding a single
length ball pushed across the batter outside off. Kohli goes chasing after it and only connects with fresh air
just over! Full on middle and off. Stops a little in the surface and Kohli is early on his lofted stroke. Just enough legs to clear Dube at mid on, though

a direct hit and Kohli might have been walking back for a golden duck! Back of a length on off. Kohli tips it to point and calls for the single. Gets sent back from half-way and Veer's throw is just off the mark. Early reprieve for Kohli!
full and wide outside off. Salt throws his hands at it and slices it over point. The ball plugs in the outfield and Henry, running around from deep backward point, cuts it off
back of a length outside off and this moves away late. Salt goes wafting at it without much foot movement and is beaten on the outside
fullish on middle and leg. A bit of shape away and Salt comes forward to push it to mid on

taken at deep mid wicket, and RCB make it four wins in a row against CSK for the first time ever! And they have done it at an absolute canter! Slower ball into the track outside off. Henry has a swipe at it and drags it towards deep mid wicket, where Salt accepts the offering with glee!
safe again! Hard length on off. Kamboj incredibly late on the pull and he splices it just beyond the bowler
excellent yorker, zoning into leg stump. Henry flicks it down to long on
full toss outside off. Kamboj is late on the stroke and jabs it into the off side
yorker outside off. Kamboj jams down on it and clinks it out into the leg side
Kamboj takes CSK past 200! Slower ball banged in short outside off. Kamboj winds up and hoicks it over deep square leg!
banged in short outside off. Henry gets up on his toes and flat-bats it over the bowler's head
into the blockhole on middle and off. Kamboj digs it out towards deep mid wicket
zinged in very full on the pads. Kamboj is late on the flick and gets jammed on the back leg
more consolatory runs! Bumper outside off. Kamboj swings like a rusty gate and skews it off the top edge over the keeper!
too wide outside off. Kamboj slashes hard at it and misses. Gets the wide, though

holes out to long on, and RCB almost there now! Bashed in short outside off, asking Noor to fetch it. He takes up the challenge but does not quite succeed. Off the bottom part of the blade and Kohli, running to his right from long on, snaffles up the chance over his right shoulder!
short and wide outside off. Noor swishes at it and misses. Called a wide too
hard length just outside off. Kamboj jams it to long off
off-pace again, on a back of a length outside off. Noor throws the kitchen sink at it and slices it towards deep point
Noor with a clean hit! In the arc on off. Seems like the knuckle ball and Noor picks it, swiping it handsomely over long on!
back of a length outside off. Noor has a wild mow at it and chunks it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
slower ball on a full length outside off. Kamboj gives it all he has and bashes it through the bowler's hands. Tough chance
googly on a length, angling into the pads. Noor plays all around it and the ball rolls off the front pad into the on side
oh! Googly on a back of a length on off. Noor swings at it with abandon and misses. Lucky to see his stumps still intact
back of a length, honing into the stumps. Played back to the bowler
another miscue but grassed this time! Back of a length outside off. Kamboj has a frail swipe at it and slices it. Abhinandan gets under it in the short third region but makes a complete hash of it
googly on a back of a length outside off. Hacked down the ground to long on

shanked a mile up, and taken! Back of a length outside off. Kicks up a little and Overton, trying to swat it down the ground, cannot get on top of the bounce. Tame chip in the end and Bethell, on as a sub, does the rest in the long off region. CSK eight down!
very full outside off. Overton cannot get under it and drags it to long on
back of a length on off. Kamboj stays back and knocks it to long on
full outside off. Overton loads up and drills it down the ground to long off
clever batting! Into the blockhole on middle and off. Overton rolls his wrists well and flicks it between square leg and short fine leg. Bhuvneshwar has overstepped too...
short and wide outside off. Overton latches onto the width and crashes it over extra cover!
chipped up but safe! Back of a length outside off. Holds in the surface and Kamboj spoons it up, somehow right between extra cover and mid off!

plonked to the skipper at extra cover, and CSK lose another! Hard length outside off. Stops a little in the surface and bounces a tad extra. Hits near the sticker as Veer looks to force it through the off side and Patidar tumbles low to his left to hold on to a sharp chance!
shortish outside off. Veer goes back and stabs it to long on

huge lbw shout, but that pitched outside leg! Googly on a fullish length. Seems to just pitch outside leg before rapping Veer on the pad, post him missing a sweep. Jitesh did a bit of vocal-chord testing but found no real support
watch out, umpire! Floated up full outside off. Veer plants his front foot and blasts it back past the bowler. The umpire had to duck for cover there!
shortish outside off. Overton sits deep in his crease and thunders it to long off
googly on a back of a length outside off. Veer jabs it to extra cover, where Krunal fumbles and allows a single
back of a length on the stumps. Overton goes back and works it into the on side

oh my - what has happened here?! Krunal pre-empts the scoop and bangs it half-way down. Veer ducks under it and loses his balance. Jitesh whips off the bails but Veer does just enough to get his left hand down. Not sure if we have seen anything like that. Ever!
four more! Even more round-arm, on a shortish length outside off. Veer goes fishing at it and clinks it off the toe-end past short third!
very round-arm, angling across the batter on a length outside off. Veer looks to dab but is beaten for pace

this is some shot! Darted in very full outside off. Veer shuffles across and somehow manages to shovel it between long on and deep mid wicket. Wanted to lap it at first but was still able to make an adequate adjustment!
smashed! Back of a length outside off. Veer takes a step across his stumps and whacks it over long on!
shot! Hung up on a length wide outside off. Veer gets his hands through the ball and scorches it past sweeper cover!
short and sliding down leg. Veer helps it to short fine leg
googly on a length outside off. Veer comes forward and defends
short on off. Overton hops back and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length on off. Veer goes back and works it to deep mid wicket
fired in on a length outside off. Veer looks for the late cut but is incredibly late on it. Not sure he picked the length early enough to play that stroke
googly on a length outside off. Veer opens his bat face and guides it towards backward point
slow and short outside off. Veer throws his hands at it and powers it towards sweeper cover
full ball on the stumps. Overton comes forward and drives it back past the bowler. Kohli makes up ground to his left from long on and reins it in
17 off the over already! Another bumper outside off. Overton keeps swiping because, well, why not. A bit of a top edge but enough to deep square leg's right to dribble into the fence!
back to back sixes for Overton! Slower ball banged in short outside off. Overton fetches it and slams it flat-batted over mid off!
Overton goes big! Back of a length on off and Overton cashes in. He stands tall and boshes it over long on!
back of a length, in and around off. Punched down the ground to long on
flighted up full outside off. Driven down the ground to long off
googly tossed up outside off. Veer lunges forward and defends with an open bat face
back of a length on leg. Overton hangs back and tugs it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single, and this is not great running
Overton has a boundary now! Back of a length on off. Overton gives himself some room and knifes it to short third's right!
length ball on the pads. Veer nudges it towards deep backward square leg
googly on a back of a length on middle and off. Overton tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
angled in full on middle and off. Overton digs it out to long on and gets off the mark

has that carried?! If it has, this is a world-class grab! Back of a length just outside off. Dube opens up his stance and swings for the hills. Gets an inside edge and Jitesh shows insane reflexes to lunge down low to his right and make it stick with his right mitt. Outstanding from Jitesh, and CSK are six down now!
dug in short on middle and leg. Dube swings at it agriculturally and chalks it towards extra cover
length outside off. Veer opens his bat face and dabs it down to deep third
very full on middle and leg. Dube eases it out to deep mid wicket
shortish on the hips. Veer tucks it into the deep square leg region. He wants two but Dube sends him back
streaky! Banged half-way down again. Dube opts to swipe at this and the ball carries off the top edge over the keeper!
back of a length outside off. Veer hangs back and jabs it towards deep backward point
very round-arm, on a back of a length outside off. Punched down the ground to long off
another seam-up short ball outside off. Dube is happy to sway out of the way
slower on a length on middle and off. Veer comes forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
four more for Veer! Krunal sticks to the seam-up short ball outside off. Veer crashes it past backward point. Not the greatest effort, it must be said!
length ball just outside off. Dube tries to tonk it into tomorrow and misses
shortish outside off. Dube gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid off
full toss and punished! Juicy and hard to turn down. Just outside off and Dube bashes it back past the non-striker!
Back of a length outside off. Veer uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
nicely done! Banged in short but sliding a touch down leg. Veer gets inside the line and helps it into the fine leg fence!
Into the blockhole just outside off. Dube jams down on it and clinks it out into the off side
greets Veer with a seam-up bumper outside off. Veer is not expecting it and is late on his attempted upper-cut

goes straight up, and Kartik falls too! Given a touch of air on a fullish length on off, and Kartik cannot resist the temptation to have a pop at it. Swings at it in an ungainly manner and only gets height on it. Abhinandan settles under it at short third, and half of CSK's side is now back in the shed!
similarly quick and short outside off. Dabbed into the off side behind point
seam-up and banged in short outside off. Dube is taken aback by it and lets it go. Wants the wide too but gets no favours from the ump
welcome, Shivam Dube! Length ball on leg stump. Dube drops down to one knee and wallops it way over deep mid wicket!

stumped by a country mile! Darted in on a length on middle and leg. Sarfaraz hares down and has a wild mow at it. Nowhere near the pitch of the ball, and the ball comes in with the angle. Past Sarfaraz's flailing blade and Jitesh whips off the bails, with Sarfaraz stranded. Sarfaraz departs for 50 off 25, but it was fun while it lasted!

fifty up for Sarfaraz, and this has been a sparkling knock! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Sarfaraz tugs it to deep mid wicket and brings up his milestone off 24 balls. Raises his bat to acknowledge the CSK support, but he knows the job is far from done!
back of a length outside off. Sarfaraz hangs back in his crease and launches it over mid on. The ball plugs incredibly and Sarfaraz has to settle for two
this is a hitting clinic! Back of a length outside off. Sarfaraz stands up on his toes and thumps it over extra cover!
another lovely stroke! Full ball on the pads and that is fodder for Sarfaraz. He rolls his wrists and clips it through square leg!
short and wide outside off. Sarfaraz rises with the bounce and lifts it over point. Back for a couple of runs

what has happened there?! Back of a length delivery wide outside off. Sarfaraz throws his bat at it, quite literally, and misses. Bat ends up near short mid wicket and the wide does not get called either
this has gone a mile up, and goes far enough too! In the slot on middle and leg. Kartik gets inside the line and hoists it over the deep mid wicket fence!
full toss outside off. Sarfaraz shanks it towards mid on
this is top-class batting! Back of a length on off. Sarfaraz hangs back but also gets down a little low to club it behind square. No ball called too!
zipped in very full on leg. Sarfaraz plays all over it and that induces an lbw shout. Going down leg, though
more runs! On the shorter side on off. Sarfaraz is anticipating that length and he shovels it over square leg!
full and speared down leg. Sarfaraz does not get bat on it again but this time, the pad is not in the vicinity. Called a wide
stand and deliver! Banged half-way down outside off. Sarfaraz picks it up early and dumps it over the deep mid wicket fence!

length ball sliding down leg. Sarfaraz seems to miss it and the umpire calls it a wide. Seemed to brush the pad, though, and RCB have reviewed. Clear brush off the thigh pad, and the decision has been reversed.

lbw shout, not given! Shortish on middle and leg. Skids through and raps Sarfaraz on the pad as he misses his swish. Seemed a touch high. In the meantime, Sarfaraz loses his bat and then has to charge across to complete the single
into the stands! Slower ball that lands right in the slot on the pads. Sarfaraz snaps his wrists into action and whips it over deep square leg!
back of a length in the channel and this shapes away late. Sarfaraz gets squared up and then nibbles at it. Beaten all ends up
back of a length on middle and leg. Sarfaraz hangs back and stabs it into the on side
up and over! Shortish outside off. Sarfaraz spots the length early, stands up tall and pounds it over mid on!
back of a length on middle and off. Sarfaraz hops around his crease before plonking it into the off side

six and out - yet again! They cannot play him! Back of a length outside off. Samson has a loose waft at it away from his body and nicks it through to Padikkal at slip. Duffy thrilled to bits; Samson and those in yellow, not quite. CSK have lost three, and we have not even finished three overs yet!
Samson with his first six of the evening! Shortish and sitting up near the hip. Samson gets inside the line and shovels it well over the fine leg fence!
back of a length on middle and leg. Sarfaraz helps it into the on side, albeit off the pad

another miscue, and Bhuvneshwar juggles it into the fence! Length just outside off. Sarfaraz looks to work to leg and gets a massive leading edge. Bhuvneshwar makes a meal of it on the deep third fence!
skewed up, but it falls into safety! Shortish on middle and leg. Gets big on Samson and he cloths his pull. Just clears mid wicket and mid on!

palmed over the bar! Back of a length outside off. Sarfaraz goes chasing after it and the ball hurtles off the outside edge towards slip. Padikkal gets his left palm to it but that was a very tough chance!
back of a length just outside off. Sarfaraz drops it behind point and looks for the single but Samson is not quite on the same page
hard length just outside off. Sarfaraz skips down and swishes at it, only to connect with fresh air
off the mark straightaway! Back of a length outside off. Shapes away and Sarfaraz gets on top of the bounce to crack it through point!

Mhatre falls too, and this CSK chase is in danger of flagging before it has even begun properly! Back of a length just outside off. Mhatre has a hack at it and gets it all wrong. Spoons it to Patidar at mid off, and Bhuvneshwar becomes the first pacer to get to 200 IPL wickets!
shortish just outside off. Mhatre hops up onto his toes and drops it into the on side with soft hands
back of a length outside off. Mhatre opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third

six and out! Duffy has the final word, and the CSK skipper's poor start to the tournament continues! Back of a length outside off. Shapes away late and Gaikwad goes nibbling at it. Gets a healthy nick and Padikkal gobbles it up to his right at slip. CSK's opening woes showing no signs of abating!
Gaikwad goes big early! Half-tracker outside off. Gaikwad picks the length early, swivels and whacks it over deep backward square leg!
fullish just outside off. Samson comes forward and pushes it enough to mid off's right for a single
back of a length on off. A bit of shape away and Gaikwad presses half forward to stab it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Samson lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
